before: Every save serialized every part in one synchronous task.
after: Saves reuse the written form of unchanged paragraphs and table rows and run in short tasks. The written bytes for a document are unchanged except the compressed form of entries longer than 256 KiB.
reason: Serialization output, shared nodes, text offsets, and operations do not change. The save captures one immutable package, so remote edits during a save go to the next save.
